title: Mainframe Modernization Company | Hypercubic
text:
Meet the Hypercubic team behind agentic AI for mainframe modernization. Backed by Y Combinator, Afore Capital, Pioneer Fund, and Rogue Holdings.

Rebuilding the critical infrastructure that runs the world.
Designed to scale.
Hypercubic is domain-specific AI to accelerate mainframe modernization. We are pioneering a new class of intelligence capable of understanding, reasoning about, and rebuilding the world’s foundational infrastructure. Top enterprises and governments trust Hypercubic to secure their critical infrastructure.
Backed by world-class investors including CIV, Y Combinator, Afore Capital, Pioneer, and more.
Leadership
Hypercubic is led by its founders, who built the company to preserve mainframe knowledge before it leaves with retiring engineers.
Aayush Naik
Co-founder
Sai Gurrapu
Co-founder
Built by leading minds behind the world's most advanced AI and technology
Our team unites top researchers, engineers, and strategists from pioneering companies and institutions—all focused on building systems that deliver real impact.
Our Values
We want Hypercubic's values to be a commitment to our customers, a testament to our ambition, and a leading indicator to our team on the culture we aim to build.
Default to action
Bias toward doing over deliberating. Move fast and decisively — then course-correct with what you learn.
Everything is soluble
No problem is fundamentally intractable. We reason from first-principles thinking and believe nothing is impossible.
Excellence is expected but never taken for granted
We hold high standards and excellence is our operating baseline, not a milestone.
